_comment: Third-party parts of the Lumi installer that are not Python packages. packaging/third_party_notices.py adds them to THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt and the release SBOM. Keep versions in step with the fetch scripts and the spec; tests/test_release_supply_chain.py checks that they agree.

not_shipped._comment: Installed as dependencies but excluded from the bundle (packaging/lumi.spec reads this list). The notices leave them out.
not_shipped.mouseinfo: GPL-3.0-or-later. A PyAutoGUI dependency for its mouseInfo() tool, which Lumi never calls; PyAutoGUI works without it.
not_shipped.pymsgbox: GPL-3.0-or-later. A PyAutoGUI dependency for alert/confirm/prompt dialogs, which Lumi never calls; PyAutoGUI works without it.

license_reviews._comment: Python packages with copyleft licenses that were reviewed and may ship: package name to the reason. third_party_notices.py fails the build for any other GPL, AGPL or LGPL package.

components.name: Python
components.note: The Python runtime embedded by PyInstaller. The minor version is the build's; see the executable for the exact release.

components.name: PyInstaller bootloader
components.note: The bootloader's exception permits distributing it with programs under any license.

components.name: WinSparkle
components.note: Windows update checks. Includes the Expat XML parser (MIT).

components.name: marked
components.note: The copyright notice is kept at the top of marked.min.js.

components.name: highlight.js
components.note: Includes the github-dark-dimmed theme. The notice is kept at the top of highlight.min.js.

components.name: DOMPurify
components.note: The license notice is kept at the top of purify.min.js.

components.name: Inter
components.note: Latin subset, weights 400 to 700, from the @fontsource/inter package.
